note: Code-rendered video templates (research; not in the plugin yet). Each card is an archetype seen in the Opus 5.5 video prompts, rewritten from scratch as our own brief (the source prompts are behavioral references only: see ../INDEX.md). `prompt` is what Claude follows to make a new version: it writes a page on runtime/mdna.js with VARS for the content, renders it with html_to_mp4.py and brings the file into AE with add_asset (route A), rebuilds it from Motion DNA presets (route B) or does both (route C: plate rendered with --notext, text and UI live in AE). Energy 1 calm .. 5 explosive, as in library/tags.json.

fields.route: A render to MP4/MOV · B native AE · C hybrid

templates.title: Showreel on the beat

vars.bpm: tempo; every cut lands on a beat
vars.words: three short words for the kinetic beat
vars.title: end title

templates.prompt: Make a {duration}s motion-design showreel at {bpm} BPM: 6-7 scenes, each one formal idea (bars sweeping, a breathing dot grid, a kinetic word swap, one shape morphing, a particle burst settling into a ring, a chart drawing itself), every cut on a beat with a one-frame accent flash, ending on a serif title card. Use only Motion DNA colours, fonts and curves; no logos.

templates.title: SaaS launch
templates.prompt: Make a {duration}s launch film for {app} (fictional): a three-line hook, then its dashboard assembles card by card (a chart, a counting balance, a list, a progress bar) while a cursor taps the key element; three feature pills land one per beat; a quick whip-zoom into the product, then an end card with a simple mark, the name and a CTA. Draw the UI as shapes (no screenshots). Support ?notext so the plate can go under live AE text.

templates.title: One shape becomes the UI
templates.prompt: Make a {duration}s UI film where one shape is never cut: it morphs by size, radius and colour into a button, a toggle, a slider, a stats card and a progress ring that ends in a check. A cursor drives every change with clicks and drags; content swaps with a short blur and separate enter/exit timing. Each state is a key of one shape (so it can be rebuilt as one AE shape layer).

templates.title: Infinite zoom
templates.prompt: Make a {duration}s single-camera film: a dot on black opens into a workspace of panels (charts, lists) that build one by one; the camera dives into one panel, pulls back until the desktop is a point among stars, then dives into a phone showing the same product. One continuous camera, log-scale zoom with Ramp curves, no cuts.

templates.title: Kinetic typography

vars.lines: lines of words; *word* marks the key word (spark, pops)

templates.prompt: Make a {duration}s kinetic-typography overlay on transparency: a manifesto read word by word, one line per shot, words rising into a mask on Land, the key word of each line in spark with a Pop, a one-word line set huge with an underline sweep, every line leaving with Launch. Rebuild natively with Motion DNA text presets when the text must stay editable.

templates.title: Storybook explainer
templates.prompt: Make a {duration}s explainer told by a character with a personality (eyes, blinks, a mood): three scenes, one formal idea each (a long trip with parallax, an obstacle with squash and stretch, an arrival where something lights up), serif captions on a pill. Everything code-drawn; captions off with ?notext.

templates.title: Timeline explainer

vars.title: headline
vars.items: [year, title, icon] milestones (icon: dot, square, people, star, globe)

templates.prompt: Make a {duration}s history timeline: a line draws left to right, the camera follows the playhead, each milestone pops a dot (Pop) and a card above or below with year, title and a small icon; at the end the camera pulls back to show the whole story. Years and titles off with ?notext.

templates.title: Data story

vars.groups: [label, count] bars the same dots regroup into

templates.prompt: Make a {duration}s data story about one number: 100 dots fall into a 10x10 waffle, the {share} that matter light up in spark one by one, the same dots regroup into labelled bars, then the headline percentage counts up and a last sentence lands. Every mark is a dot you can count; sentences off with ?notext.

templates.title: Particle world
templates.prompt: Make a seamless {duration}s loop of a 3D place drawn with thousands of glowing specks (no solid fills): rolling waves of particles, a sun made of particles, a slow camera sway, the light going from day to dusk and back so the loop closes. Project the points by hand on a 2D canvas (no libraries).

templates.title: Shader hero object

vars.colours: pine / sea / spark / cloud in the shader

templates.prompt: Make a {duration}s hero product plate as one fragment shader: a ray-marched glossy object (a torus that breathes into a capsule) on a studio floor with soft shadow, spark rim light, slow turntable and push-in. The shader reads only uTime so every frame renders the same.

templates.title: Liquid wipe
templates.prompt: Make a {duration}s transition overlay on transparency: a spark leading edge and a pine body sweep across with wobbling noisy fronts (Whip), fully cover the frame at the midpoint (cut the shots there), then uncover with the spark trailing (Surge).

templates.title: Logo reveal

vars.name: wordmark (fictional)
vars.mark: three colours for disc, bar, arc

templates.prompt: Make a {duration}s logo reveal on transparency for a fictional mark built from three primitives (disc, bar, arc): each part flies in on its own curve (Wind-up, Whip, Settle), they lock with a Pop, the mark slides left, the wordmark types on letter by letter and the tagline settles. Never use a real brand's logo.

templates.title: Install tutorial (app walkthrough)

vars.app: the app window being walked through (fictional or our own UI)

templates.prompt: Make a {duration}s step-by-step install tutorial: a desktop app window drawn in code over a soft blurred office background, a cursor that clicks through each step, a numbered step card (STEP n OF 7, title, one line) and a progress bar; each step lands on its voice line, with gaps left for presenter clips between steps.

templates.title: Pixel character (documented rig)
inspired_by: ClaudeAnimationBase (MIT): a rig with views, emotions and an acted mood change

vars.character: slug of a character with a pixel style

templates.prompt: Make a {duration}s pixel-art short where a documented character acts one beat: it rolls in, looks around, reads an order, reacts (squash, hop, land) as its screen swaps emotion, waves and celebrates; poses on twos, the eyes lead the body, the world at 240x135 scaled x8, Motion DNA type on top. The character is drawn from its character.json by runtime/pixel_rig.js; ?sheet renders its character sheet from the same file.
